policy: Belgium transports the immutable public Microcosm US Build P support artifact into a synthetic Belgian population (BE-MC2). Donor records remain US support records and retain their support-stratum provenance; Belgian geography is assigned, never source-observed. Destination calibration uses Belgian administrative and national-accounts targets from sums of Chronicle facts; surveys are validation-only. chronicle_feed.json pins the Chronicle consumer artifact (B3); the rulespec-be tree remains a declared unpinned placeholder, so this package remains inactive. Executable Python belongs in shared runtimes; publication remains private pending Max's decision in release_contract.json.

stages.survey: Microcosm US Build P support population (US donor support records)

artifacts.integrity_note: The revision is the immutable release tag named by the public latest.json pointer on 2026-08-29. Execution must verify both SHA-256 and byte size before reading; main/latest fallback is forbidden.

stages.notes: The first artifact copies the authenticated donor pin from build/nz/source_stages.json exactly. Shared transport must preserve donor entity ids, membership, typed household design weights and support strata, retain US donor provenance, and bridge donor mass to a Chronicle-supplied Belgian population total with a conservation receipt. The second artifact names chronicle_feed.json, which pins the PolicyEngine/chronicle consumer artifact by its facts, manifest and schema hashes (B3); the third is a declared placeholder for the TheAxiomFoundation/rulespec-be tree, whose RuleSpec commit and tree hashes are not authored here. Neither reference permits a latest/main fallback. Later work must supply the RuleSpec pins, source materialization, unit construction, engine bindings and an executable graph. Monetary conversion and quantile mapping are later declarations (B4); the catalog's money columns use the shared eur unit.
